meta.title: Barnette algebra routes
meta.subtitle: T2 unreviewed proofs and T4 exact-count evidence

nodes.title: Quartic integral and Gaussian decoupling
nodes.statement: F equals a quartic Berezin integral and an expectation of two determinants. Integrand sign remains uncontrolled.

nodes.title: Positive squared-minor representation
nodes.statement: The double-transversal coefficient of the root-contracted opposite-edge Laplacian equals the tree count.

nodes.title: Unsigned and signed support barriers
nodes.statement: Tree coefficients have both signs; positive incidence rescaling preserves them; face/vertex multiplicative substitution annihilates F.

nodes.title: Cube destroys real stability
nodes.statement: The unsigned cube tree polynomial abc+def vanishes in the upper half-plane.

nodes.title: Hamiltonian edge avoidance is even
nodes.statement: Deduction from Thomason Corollary 1.5 for cubic bipartite graphs.

nodes.title: All facial roots through order sixteen
nodes.statement: 297 plantri triangulations and all 7,868 roots, plus 102 named-example and fixture roots. Counts use exact integers.

nodes.title: Small-prime positivity fails
nodes.statement: Positive tree counts divisible by each of 2,3,4,5,7,11 occur.
nodes.lesson: Unweighted residues do not force positivity by avoiding zero.

nodes.title: Unrooted invariant equality fails
nodes.statement: One unobstructed triangulation has root-dependent tree counts 2 and 8.
nodes.lesson: A prospective invariant must retain the root or a prescribed coefficient.

nodes.title: Signed incidence gauge fails
nodes.statement: A six-tree-state sign certificate prevents an incidence sign gauge from making every coefficient positive.
nodes.lesson: The obstruction persists beyond positive rescalings and local tensor factorization.

nodes.title: A transparent coefficient-support theorem
nodes.statement: Prove the two endpoint partitions admit a nonzero opposite-edge minor whenever a pair exists.
nodes.next: Seek a special planar three-matroid support theorem rather than generic PSD positivity.

nodes.title: Marked Alon-Tarsi coefficient
nodes.statement: A directed graph could encode the minimum-cycle marked imbalance.
nodes.test: Construct its orientation polynomial on the cube and a two-cycle input; compare every coefficient.
nodes.vivid: The disk index controls orientation signs, but no directed graph encoding is known.
